resource_title: Cartografía de radios censales de Argentina corregidos, completados y estandarizados de 1991, 2001, 2010 y 2022
license_evidence: CONICET Digital record 11336/149711 states that, except where explicitly noted, the item is published under Creative Commons Attribution 2.5 Unported (CC BY 2.5).
attribution: Rodriguez, Gonzalo Martin; Consejo Nacional de Investigaciones Científicas y Técnicas (CONICET), CEUR.
citation: Rodriguez, Gonzalo Martin; (2022): Cartografía de radios censales de Argentina corregidos, completados y estandarizados de 1991, 2001, 2010 y 2022. Consejo Nacional de Investigaciones Científicas y Técnicas. (dataset). http://hdl.handle.net/11336/149711
methodology: Curated longitudinal research cartography. The record describes backward harmonization using 2022 geometry as the basis for 2010, 2010 for 2001, and 2001 for 1991, together with corrections/completions and standardized unchanged boundaries.
known_limitations: CEUR is a curated-research geography and must not be represented as byte-equivalent official INDEC census-operation cartography.
The dataset deliberately corrects, completes and standardizes census-radio geometry for research use.
Native schema and identifier authority must be characterized from the exact V2025-1 file before normalization.
No INDEC-versus-CEUR preference or winner policy is implied by adopting this source as an independent geography authority.
